sloka: स तु राममवेक्षन्तं सुमन्त्रं प्रेक्ष्य दुर्मना: ।कुशोत्तरमुपस्थाप्य भूमावेवास्तरत् स्वयम् ॥ २.१११.१५॥
transliteration: sa tu rāmamavekṣantaṁ sumantraṁ prekṣya durmanā: ।kuśottaramupasthāpya bhūmāvevāstarat svayam ॥ 2.111.15॥

translations.english: Bharata was mentally disturbed saw Sumantra waiting for Rama's order. Then he himself brought a heap of kusa grass and spread it on the ground.
